correctness.rationale: A packet reversal has sign (-1)^(length choose 2); the ordered composition weights are p^(m-1)(1-p)^(n-m), so multiplying the signed single-packet series and summing the geometric series gives the stated denominator and initial conditions. With r=sqrt(1-p) the oscillatory solution has numerator sin(nθ)-r sin((n-1)θ), where p=2r cos θ. The argument shift of 1-r exp(-iθ) is arctan(sin θ/sqrt(1+cos²θ)), strictly increasing with positive derivative for 0<θ<π/2, with endpoint limits 0 and π/4. The increasing total phase runs strictly between 0 and nπ/2+π/4, giving exactly floor(n/2) positive integer multiples of π; the phase and parameter derivatives are nonzero at each crossing. At the repeated-root endpoint the formula limits to r^(n-1)[n-(n-1)r]>0. Above it both characteristic roots lie in (q,1); x^(n-1)(x-q) is strictly increasing there, giving positivity by the difference quotient. The zeros in θ differ from jπ/n by less than π/(4n), so the empirical law is the pushforward of the uniform θ law. Differentiating the inverse cosine gives precisely the stated density; the radicand has a simple endpoint zero. Below p* irrational rotations give both signs, and rational rotations form a repeated orbit of at least five equally spaced angles, which cannot stay in either closed semicircle. Multiplicativity of sign gives the exact parity distance; full reversal is a fixed sign factor under the alternate convention.
residual_risks: Endpoint p=0 is excluded. Uniformity here is only on the two-element parity quotient; no all-permutation mixing claim is verified.

value.rationale: Parity is the canonical two-point quotient of the walk. Determining all parameter values for one-step stationary parity at every deck size, and resolving their density and endpoint concentration, answers a natural exact randomization question not captured by the full-deck mixing scale. The novelty-bearing part is the root classification in the physical cut parameter rather than just a recurrence evaluation or a standard TV projection formula.
residual_risks: No broader speed-up or conclusion for the full permutation distribution follows.
